comment: The document contains three independent page-numbering sequences that each begin at 1: the contents pages, the glossary, and the executive summary and body. Printed page "1" therefore occurs three times and "2" twice. Because the comment template asks reviewers to cite section, page and line, references in submitted comments will be ambiguous, and comparison of comments across reviewers will be harder than it needs to be.
